summary: Job template sync settings: sync.jobTemplates.enabled (default true), optional surveyEnabled and labels (default []) filters, and schedule.frequency and schedule.timeout, which are required when template sync is enabled.
questions: How do I disable job template sync in the portal?
What job template sync options does the portal support?
Is schedule required for jobTemplates sync?

answer_card.title: Job template sync settings
answer_card.answer_md:
| Option | Type | Requirement | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sync.jobTemplates.enabled` | boolean | required | `true` |
| `sync.jobTemplates.surveyEnabled` | boolean | optional | - |
| `sync.jobTemplates.labels` | array | optional | `[]` |
| `sync.jobTemplates.schedule.frequency` | object | required if enabled | e.g. `{ minutes: 60 }` |
| `sync.jobTemplates.schedule.timeout` | object | required if enabled | e.g. `{ minutes: 15 }` |
